inherits.numerical_gates: benchmarks/protocols/comparison_v1.json (unchanged; exact finite bits incl. signed zero, masks, state; frozen original-reference gates)
inherits.resource_policy: 12 GiB process-tree cap sampled at 20 ms; 10 GiB disk reserve; exclusive host lease for all timed trials

tiers.L0: tiny arrays/state machines, exact equality, negative controls; <60 s per command
tiers.L1: actual-kernel differential vs untouched original function, 16-128 pixels per side (256 only with recorded reason), all 153 patches where patch arithmetic is involved, all returns/mutations/dtypes/masks; <180 s per command; worker tests use <=2 native threads
tiers.L2: real small TIFF full chronological pipeline (dense_urban_256 or vegetation_rich_256), 24 timesteps, 153 patches, all 10 outputs, checkpoint_interval=1; compare all 24-band outputs + state vs pre-change reference on the same source identity; <300 s per command
tiers.L3: central lab only (coordinator): 128/256 fixtures, <=2 variants per family, AB/BA paired, exclusive host; <=600 s per session
tiers.L4: final only, one candidate attempt by default after source/wheel/env freeze

L4: plus the frozen 24-tile batch definition in final_protocol_v1.json (written at freeze time)

reference_discipline.golden_source: references come from the untouched ORIGINAL functions/modules or pre-change pipeline runs recorded BEFORE candidate integration; candidate code never generates its own golden
reference_discipline.first_wave: each family records a pre-change L2 reference bundle (output TIFFs + final state digest + checkpoint digests) on the pristine integration tip before its first edit touches shared dispatch; family-owned kernels may differentially test against the in-repo original function directly
reference_discipline.identity: evidence reuse only under dependency-identity match (source bytes, deps, fixture bits, harness, config)

failure_preservation: dense1024 TMRT Linux p8 gate failure stays recorded as-is (different host; no local large parity claim inherits it)
four inherited SVF/UMEP exceptions remain failed-by-disposition
any new failing fixture is retained and reported, never skipped

concurrency.worker_local_tests: L0/L1 only, <=2 native threads, disjoint fixtures; pause during any coordinator timed trial
concurrency.exclusive_lease: coordinator holds it; census/L3/L4 run alone
